title: Tübingen registry for familial Mediterranean fever and other autoinflammatory diseases
summary: The aim of this registry is to identify clinical differences of subgroups, also with the question about the origin of the patients, familial clustering and relevant other autoimmune diseases. For this purpose, a one-time questionnaire is used to determine the severity of the disease and the family history, which is supplemented with the clinical data from the patient's file.
conditions: Other specified systemic involvement of connective tissue
